events.verdict: Fox (SAC) maintains his pivot foot prior to the jump shot attempt.
Daniels (ATL) legally contests the jump shot attempt from Fox (SAC). Fox extends his leg as part of a normal shooting motion and the ensuing contact with Daniels is incidental.
Young (ATL) maintains his pivot foot prior to releasing the pass.
Young (ATL) avoids stepping into the backcourt prior to releasing the pass.
Fox (SAC) makes clean contact with the ball as he defends the pass to Daniels (ATL).
Lyles (SAC) swipes down and initiates contact to Capela's (ATL) left wrist, which affects his layup attempt.
Ellis (SAC) cleanly blocks Capela's (ATL) layup attempt.
McLaughlin (SAC) and Daniels (ATL) briefly engage and disengage.

events.verdict: Young (ATL) is the last player to touch the ball before his pass goes out of bounds.
Mathews (ATL) extends his hands into Ellis's (SAC) body, moving him off of his spot as he attempts to set the screen.
Huerter (SAC) briefly places both hands on Hunter's (ATL) body as he sets the screen, but the contact is marginal.
Huerter (SAC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Young (ATL) keeps his hand on the side of the ball during his dribble.
Huerter (ATL) moves alongside of Young's (ATL) path and the body contact is marginal.
Daniels (ATL) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Fox's (SAC) possession and any contact with Fox's hand on the ball is considered incidental.
Daniels (ATL) avoids stepping out of bounds prior to releasing the pass.
